community_list_entries.name: MetaKernelBench: Measuring GPU Kernel Knowledge Transfer Beyond Code

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Benchmark (74 paired CuTe/TIRx GPU-kernel problems) of the reuse value of retained experience. The agent distills a natural-language skill during a solo attempt in one DSL, and the skill is the only extra input to a fresh attempt in the other DSL; scoring is paired lift in correctness and runtime. C

phase1_verified_types.procedural_workflow: Abstract: "instructed to distill what it learns into a natural-language skill ... The skill is the only extra input to a skill-conditioned attempt"; Sec 3.3 Eq.3 paired lift/help/harm rates
phase1_verified_types.coding_cross_session: Abstract: agents "retain what they learn in knowledge bases or as distilled skills"; benchmarks "leave the reuse value of retained experience unmeasured." §2.2: "fresh execution"; skill is "the only additional task input".
